item.title: 7 Minutes of Some of the Best Surf of the Los Angeles Winter
item.description: Some mornings are just better than others. This is seven minutes of some of the best surf of the Los Angeles winter thus far.

item.title: Red Bull Picks Up 14-Year-Old Phenom Surfer Tya Zebrowski
item.description: Red Bull is placing its bets on the future of Tya Zebrowski, who will be the youngest surfer to ever compete on the WSL's Championship Tour.

item.title: The Best Women’s Hiking Boots of 2026
item.description: Whether you're backpacking or day hiking, a good pair of hiking boots makes all the difference. These are the best women's hiking boots we've tested lately.

item.title: The Perfect Chapter Tube-Riding Contest Adds Indonesia and Mozambique
item.description: The Portuguese barrel-riding event, Perfect Chapter, is going global, adding two more stops in 2026 including Mozambique and Indonesia.

item.title: Meteotsunami Kills 1, Injures 35 on Argentina Beach
item.description: An Argentinian beach was struck by a rare weather-induced wave called a meteotsunami, which caused dozens of injuries and at least one fatality.

item.title: Maverick’s at Its Finest: One Year Later, Luca Padua Breaks Down a Historic Swell
item.description: A year ago, Maverick's went wild. Luca Padua was there and he will never forget what happened. December 23 was one of the biggest days in Maverick's history.

item.title: Paddling a Surfboard Is a Desperate Act
item.description: We pay so much attention to riding a surfboard, that sometimes we forget about the paddling. And when things get heavy, it can be a desperate act.

item.title: Watch Gordon Ramsay Make a Hawaiian-Style SPAM Sandwich on the Big Island
item.description: Gordon Ramsay is a good cook. Ramsay headed to the Big Island to make a staple: a SPAM sandwich. But not just any old SPAM sandwich. Ramsay elevated it.

item.title: Skier Caught in Avalanche With Dog Captures It All on Video
item.description: Ares Masip was skiing with her dog Cim when she inadvertently triggered an avalanche. She came out of the mishap unscathed and caught the whole thing on video.

item.title: Surfer Uriah McDonald Is the World’s Gnarliest 8-Year-Old
item.description: At just eight years old, Uriah McDonald has already paddled out at Pipeline and Teahupo'o. He's got the stoke. And when you have the stoke, anything's possible.
